description: For a UN-coordinated humanitarian appeal or response plan (HRP/CAP/flash appeal and similar single-country plans) at its public launch instant (requirements first published - GHO early December for the following year, or the plan's own release, whichever the record dates), will the plan receive funding equal to at least 50% of its ORIGINAL (launch-vintage) requirements by the close of its plan year? Features are launch-time attributes (original requirements, plan type, GHO membership, country, plan year) plus the appeal-recency gap to the country's most recent strictly-earlier appeal (years_since_country_prior; -1 when the country has no prior appeal). No prior-outcome history ships: the 2026.10-era prior-outcome features allowed exact cross-row label recovery and were removed after the 2026-11-01 queue audit. A useful prediction identifies, months ahead, which appeals will end the year underfunded - the quantity GHO gap analysis reports after the fact - enabling donor advocacy and fundraising prioritization.
name: ocha-fts-appeal-funding-trajectory
split: temporal on the plan year: train 2000-2016, eval 2017-2020, holdout 2021-2025
split_description: temporal on the plan year: train 2000-2016, eval 2017-2020, holdout 2021-2025 (the 2026+ live edge is excluded until those years close; exclusions are counted, never scored)
